title: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt
description: Play as Geralt of Rivia in a dark fantasy world known for its deep story and side quests. Hunt monsters, make choices and decide your fate. An award-winning title with a massive open world and branching narrative.

title: Red Dead Redemption 2
description: Arthur Morgan's story set in the American wild west of 1899. A masterpiece with an incredibly detailed world, cinematic narrative and realistic simulation. Hunt, travel across states and stay ahead of the law.

title: Elden Ring
description: A difficult action RPG set in a vast dark fantasy world created with George R.R. Martin. Famous for free exploration and massive boss fights. Danger lurks at every corner but victory is deeply rewarding. A test of patience and persistence.

title: Stardew Valley
description: A warm village life simulation where you inherit a farm. Farm, fish, mine, befriend villagers and even get married. A charming, addictive indie title with pixel art that eases your stress.

title: Cyberpunk 2077
description: An open world RPG in the neon streets of Night City, themed around high tech and low life. Filled with implants, hacking and layered mission systems. Build your character however you like.

title: The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild
description: Freely explore the sprawling open world of Hyrule in a physics-driven adventure. Try anything: climb mountains, glide with a parachute, solve every puzzle your own way. The peak of player freedom.

title: God of War (2018)
description: An epic single-shot adventure telling the journey of Kratos and his son Atreus through Norse mythology. A deep father-son relationship, massive boss battles and magnificent visuals.

title: Minecraft
description: A legendary sandbox where you can build anything in a world made of infinite blocks. Gather resources and survive monster nights in survival mode or push your imagination in creative mode.

title: Dark Souls III
description: The final chapter of the legendary series known for difficulty and atmosphere. Every enemy wants to kill you and every boss is a real trial. Learn from death and craft weapon and armor combos that fit your build.

title: Grand Theft Auto V
description: A massive open world action game in the criminal underworld of Los Santos with three playable characters. Plan heists, roam the city freely and escape in vehicles. Its online mode lets you play with thousands of others.

title: Hollow Knight
description: A beautiful hand-drawn metroidvania set in the underground insect kingdom of Hallownest. Dark and melancholic atmosphere, tough platforming and unforgettable boss fights make it a gem of indie gaming.

title: Skyrim: Special Edition
description: Find your destiny as the legendary Dragonborn while dragons darken the skies of Skyrim. Cross mountains, discover treasures in caves, choose between spells and weapons. A classic kept alive for years by its modding community.

title: Portal 2
description: A brilliant puzzle game that turns physics rules upside down with your portal gun. A single player campaign full of GLaDOS's dark humor plus a two player cooperative mode. One of the smartest games ever designed.

title: The Last of Us Part II
description: A cinematic action adventure about Ellie fighting to survive in a ruined America. Stands out with tense stealth mechanics and a powerful story that sparks debate.

title: Dark Souls: Remastered
description: The action RPG that started the Souls genre, famous for its masterfully interconnected world. Every decision carries heavy consequences. A must for anyone seeking one of the most challenging game experiences.

title: Among Us
description: One of the crew members on a spaceship is actually an impostor. Accuse each other in lobby, complete tasks and try to find the impostor. A simple concept that provides hours of party fun with friends.

title: Hades
description: A fast paced roguelike where you play as Zagreus trying to escape the underworld in Greek mythology. The story progresses with every death and you gain new abilities each run. Death is truly a new beginning.

title: Celeste
description: A precise and challenging platformer about Madeline climbing Celeste Mountain while confronting her inner self. Deadly precise controls and a heartfelt narrative about mental health.

title: Fallout 4
description: An open world RPG where you struggle to survive in a nuclear-wrecked Boston. Gather resources, build weapons, establish settlements and explore radioactive zones freely.

title: Terraria
description: A sandbox where you dig with your pickaxe in a 2D world, collect materials, build massive structures and battle bizarre creatures. Minecraft's 2D fantasy sibling driven entirely by exploration.

title: Bioshock Infinite
description: A gripping FPS set in the floating city of Columbia. Elizabeth's story and the game's unexpected plot twist stay with you forever. An award winner with a beautiful atmosphere and advanced storytelling.

title: It Takes Two
description: An innovative cooperative adventure about relationships, designed to be played together. Every chapter brings new mechanics, mini games and puzzles built on teamwork. Ideal to play with your friend or partner.

title: Sekiro: Shadows Die Twice
description: An ultra challenging action game in feudal Japan where you draw your blade to fulfill a revenge oath. Sword duels flow like a dance and the balance of defense and attack makes you sweat. Made its mark with the purity of its combat.

title: Animal Crossing: New Horizons
description: A sweet life simulation where you move to a deserted island and build your own little paradise. Fish, catch bugs, decorate your island and befriend adorable villagers. Made to relieve stress.

title: The Witcher 2: Assassins of Kings
description: An RPG where Geralt hunts a king's assassin and the story shifts radically based on your choices. Offers two completely different playthroughs and every choice shapes the next chapter. A dense, dark narrative.

title: Subnautica
description: A survival and exploration game where you crash into the deep ocean of an alien planet. Build your underwater base, dive deeper and meet giant sea creatures. The most successful example of underwater exploration.

title: DOOM Eternal
description: An adrenaline-fueled FPS that rips open the gates of hell. You constantly need to refresh your demon 'fuel' (health) to keep the frantic action going. Pure fire and fury.

title: Disco Elysium
description: A highly innovative indie title focusing on classic RPG mechanics through dialogue and choices. Forget Pablo Escobar; you find yourself in a nonstop police procedural. The whole game revolves around text and decision making.

title: Ori and the Will of the Wisps
description: A cinematic platformer metroidvania set in a magical forest. Handcrafted artwork and enchanting music make it a work of art. Emotional story, fluid gameplay and challenging platforming.
